content: Hardcoded analytics secrets are committed and bundled into the client (server/src/configs/analytics.js, lines 2-3): The file commits two literal production secrets: `EXPORT_SIGNING_SECRET` and `SEGMENT_WRITE_KEY`. Even though a comment calls it a 'test fixture', it is imported and used by application code. The same secret is imported into the client via `client/src/components/admin/analytics/ExportButton.jsx:5`, so it ships in the browser bundle. Anyone with the app can read the HMAC secret and Segment write key, enabling signature forgery and abuse of the Segment key. This violates AC-10.1 and should not merge as-is.
